name: Chromecast
description: Discovers Google Cast (Chromecast) devices on the local network and exposes each one as a session in Jellyfin's existing cast/remote-control interface. Casting is handed off to Jellyfin's own cast receiver app, so it works the same way it already does for Chrome/Android users - but from every client, including iOS/iPadOS/macOS.
overview: Cast to Google Cast devices from Jellyfin's built-in cast interface, on every client including iOS/iPadOS/macOS.
